description: Authoritative RFC 0001 Phase E tool cohort ledger. Wrapper sites are exact current debt, not permissions for new indirection. A cohort is retired only after its deletion conditions and current acceptance evidence pass.

abiDeclarations.reason: Vendored VPC compatibility declaration; it is not authority for new engine or tool wrappers.
deleteWhen: the external VPC binlaunch consumer is retired or moved to its owning upstream compatibility boundary
